notes: Create-a-class: the lobby shows the chosen gun turning in 3D with its sight, barrel, laser and skin. New attachments: drum magazine (SMG, pistol; 2.5x rounds) and The Switch (pistol full auto). Six new skins: Diamond (BO2 style), Carbon Fiber, Galaxy, Frost, Bloodshot, and a locked Dragon sniper skin that breathes fire from the barrel. Killcam text moved into a calling card along the bottom (emblem, name, rank, gun); the yellow marker is gone from the solo preview.
